caption:
Your CRM is holding revenue you already paid to acquire.

Home-services reactivation benchmarks show multichannel win-back campaigns, combining SMS, email, and voice, outperform single-channel outreach by roughly 2-3X.

The part most owners miss: timing beats effort. Contacts reached within 90 days of going quiet respond far more than contacts left cold for a year or two.

This week, pull every contact untouched for 90+ days. Text first, one line, no discount yet. Let email and a call follow if they stay quiet.

rationale: Third-Party Research is under-served this cycle; cites qualified home-services reactivation patterns and routes to the platform's verified win-back automation, an angle no prior post has run this way.
